ProjectDescription: This site will enable users to create or join local cryonics groups. Member lists and emergency calldown lists are curated by each individual group for rapid retrieval in case of emergency. Each member can fill out as much as or as little information as they want. Built in React with a MongoDB backend.

This site will authenticate users, and allow them to link to a fitbit account. When the watch unexpectedly loses a heart rate signal, this server will notify emergency contacts. The clock face app that was developed separately will ping to this server if HR is lost. A member dashboard shows users status and alert status including GPS location.

TitleOfProject: MN Cryonics HR monitor fitbit clockface app
ProjectDescription: This is the companion app that is installed on the fitbit sense. Written in Fitbit studio this app will monitor heart rate and send an alert to the webpage that will then send texts/phone calls to emergency contacts

This react native mobile app currently sets alarms for users to check in. If there is no response the server will send texts and calls to the users emergency contacts. Automatic check ins with a smart watch or EKG device are planned for the future. Bluetooth connectivity with mobile app has been tested and working. Development beyond that is in progress. Testing done with users via Expo builds and Apple TestFlight.

This React mobile friendly web app will allow players of the game phasmaphobia to quickly filter out what clues are needed to identify the ghost they are facing. Simple one click interface to cycle between confirmed, excluded or unknown. My code will then show what clues need to be investigated or which ones can be ignored.
